# 2048

## What is 2048?

2048 is the hit game from 2014.

The goal of the game is to obtain a 2048 by merging equal numbers to make a single one, twice as big.

The interface presented here is minimal: no undo button, no fancy graphics, no sound, just pure gaming.

## How does 2048 rando work?

Your ability to merge things is taken away, you start unable to merge anything, the ability to merge things is shuffled in the pool.

The locations are: getting every power of 2 up to 2048, and getting to some score thresholds.

Do note that getting a number doesn't mean you have to get it through a merge, you are expected to clear the "Have a 2" and "Have a 4" locations without any item.

## Once I'm inside the 2048 client, how do I actually play 2048?

Arrow keys to move all the numbers in the grid, merging numbers if able. There is also a reset button above the grid.

## Special Thanks

This apworld's code is *heavily* inspired by APQuest, so my thanks go to Vi, this apworld probably without exist without them

# 2048 Randomizer Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [The 2048 apworld](https://github.com/Ishigh1/Archipelago/releases/latest)
  (if not bundled with your version of Archipelago)

## How to play

First, you need a room to connect to. For this, you or someone you know has to generate a game.  
This will not be explained here,
but you can check the [Archipelago Setup Guide](/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en#generating-a-game).

You also need to have [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) installed
and the [The 2048 apworld](https://github.com/Ishigh1/Archipelago/releases/latest) installed into Archipelago.

From here, connecting to your 2048 slot is easy. There are two scenarios.

### Webhost Room

If your room is hosted on a WebHost (e.g. [archipelago.gg](https://archipelago.gg)),
you should be able to simply click on your name in the player list.  
This will open the Archipelago Launcher
and ask you whether you want to connect with the Text Client or the 2048 Client.  
Choose "2048 Client". The rest should happen completely automatically and you should be able to play 2048.

### Locally hosted room

If your room does not have a WebHost room page available, you can launch 2048 manually.  

Open the Archipelago Launcher, and then select the 2048 Client from the list.  
After a short while, the 2048 client should open.  
Enter the server address at the top and click "Connect".  
Then, enter your name. If a password exists, enter the password.  
You should now be connected and able to play 2048.

## Switching Rooms

The 2048 Client can seamlessly switch rooms without restarting.

Simply click the "Disconnect" button, then connect to a different slot/room.
